evals.name: upload-notice
evals.prompt: Add a notice under the photo upload button on our church site saying people shouldn't upload copyrighted images. Our terms are at /terms and clause 7 is 'Your content'.
evals.expected_output: One or two plain sentences that say what to do, linked to /terms#clause-7 opening in a new tab, no checkbox, plus owner decisions.

assertions.text: writes one or two plain sentences framed as what to do (upload only what you own or have permission to share)
does not add a checkbox to the upload
does not renumber or rewrite clause 7
ends with the decisions that belong to the owner or a lawyer

evals.name: privacy-policy-from-code
evals.prompt: Write a privacy policy for our Next.js app. We use Supabase for auth and Stripe for payments.
evals.expected_output: Starts from the bundled US privacy template, reads providers and cookies from the code, cuts template text the product doesn't do, lists governing law and other choices as owner decisions.

assertions.text: uses the bundled privacy-policy template rather than writing from scratch
says it will read or has read the providers, cookies and data collected from the code or config, naming files
does not pick governing law, venue or arbitration on the owner's behalf
states that this is not legal advice and names what a lawyer should review

evals.name: new-clause-appended
evals.prompt: Our terms already have clauses 1-12 published. Add a rule that users can't use the service to train AI models.
evals.expected_output: Appends a new clause 13 with an anchor, never renumbers.

assertions.text: adds the rule as a new clause at the end (13) or a sub-clause, with an anchor
